note: Issue #29: reminders that the AI characters are not real people. Read by src/systems/llm/disclaimers.gd. 'launch' is shown once each time the game starts; 'talk' sits at the top of every conversation; 'repeat' is posted again in the conversation whenever the player's message contains a trigger. Triggers match whole words, also with s, es, d, ed, ing, er or ers on the end (so 'kill' catches 'kills', 'killing' and 'killer' but not 'skill'); a trigger with a space matches that phrase. %s is the character's name.

launch.title: Before you play
launch.text:
Some characters in this game are run by AI. What they say is generated by a computer program as you talk to them. They are not real people, they do not know you, and they can be wrong, strange or inconsistent.

Do not rely on them for advice about your real life. If anything they say upsets you, step away and talk to someone you trust.

talk: %s is an AI character. Replies are generated by a computer and can be wrong. Not a real person.
repeat: Reminder: %s is an AI character in a game, not a real person, and cannot help with real-life problems. If you are thinking about hurting yourself or someone else, please reach out to someone you trust or a local crisis line.
